items.text: For buyers · What a permanent holder carries
A retention rate is a median. The customers behind it are what you will hold.

Published retention figures for private software companies differ by twenty-one points, depending on who was measured. A holder with no exit needs the answer for one company, and for the customers behind it.
Median net revenue retention, one survey
Private software companies with $3M to $20M of recurring revenue, mostly bootstrapped. Gross retention in the same survey: 91 percent.
Median net revenue retention, another
Billing-platform data across private B2B software companies. A different population of companies, not a measurement error.
Healthcare providers’ share of August 2026 liability management transactions
The largest single group, ahead of software and IT services at 11 percent each. In healthcare software, these are the customers.
Broken letters of intent that died on a finding outside the earnings work
A license, a contract, a compliance gap, a customer concentration. Up from 19.1 percent in 2023.

SaaS Capital, annual survey of more than 1,000 private B2B SaaS companies, 24 April 2026. ChartMogul, billing-platform data, 10 December 2025. The two retention figures measure different populations and are shown side by side, not averaged. PitchBook LCD, 2 September 2026. A lower-middle-market deal platform’s published study of broken letters of intent, 27 January 2026: seventy-five broken letters across eight buyer types and eight industries, with 2023 comparisons from the same series. The percentages are separate reported categories and are not summed here.
